```{r}
def_pos_mat <- function(num) {
  A <- matrix(runif(num^2)*2-1, ncol=num) 
  return (t(A) %*% A)
}

draw_confusion_matrix <- function(cm) {

  #layout(matrix(c(1,1,2)))
  par(mar=c(2,2,2,2))
  plot(c(100, 345), c(300, 450), type = "n", xlab="", ylab="", xaxt='n', yaxt='n')

  # create the matrix 
  rect(150, 430, 240, 370, col='#3F97D0')
  text(195, 435, 'i', cex=3)
  rect(250, 430, 340, 370, col='#F7AD50')
  text(295, 435, 'ii', cex=3)
  text(125, 370, 'Predicted', cex=3, srt=90, font=2)
  text(245, 450, 'Actual', cex=3, font=2)
  rect(150, 305, 240, 365, col='#F7AD50')
  rect(250, 305, 340, 365, col='#3F97D0')
  text(140, 400, 'i', cex=3, srt=90)
  text(140, 335, 'ii', cex=3, srt=90)

  # add in the cm results 
  res <- as.numeric(cm$table)
  text(195, 400, res[1], cex=4, font=2, col='white')
  text(195, 335, res[2], cex=4, font=2, col='white')
  text(295, 400, res[3], cex=4, font=2, col='white')
  text(295, 335, res[4], cex=4, font=2, col='white')

  # # add in the specifics 
  # plot(c(100, 0), c(100, 0), type = "n", xlab="", ylab="", main = "DETAILS", xaxt='n', yaxt='n')
  # text(10, 85, names(cm$byClass[1]), cex=1.2, font=2)
  # text(10, 70, round(as.numeric(cm$byClass[1]), 3), cex=1.2)
  # text(30, 85, names(cm$byClass[2]), cex=1.2, font=2)
  # text(30, 70, round(as.numeric(cm$byClass[2]), 3), cex=1.2)
  # text(50, 85, names(cm$byClass[5]), cex=1.2, font=2)
  # text(50, 70, round(as.numeric(cm$byClass[5]), 3), cex=1.2)
  # text(70, 85, names(cm$byClass[6]), cex=1.2, font=2)
  # text(70, 70, round(as.numeric(cm$byClass[6]), 3), cex=1.2)
  # text(90, 85, names(cm$byClass[7]), cex=1.2, font=2)
  # text(90, 70, round(as.numeric(cm$byClass[7]), 3), cex=1.2)
  # 
  # # add in the accuracy information 
  # text(30, 35, names(cm$overall[1]), cex=1.5, font=2)
  # text(30, 20, round(as.numeric(cm$overall[1]), 3), cex=1.4)

}
```

# Figure 1: Synthetic data test

```{r create synthetic data, include=FALSE}
# https://www.r-bloggers.com/2016/02/generating-and-visualizing-multivariate-data-with-r/

library(MASS)
set.seed(123)
n_feats <- 100

# Mean
mu_a_yg <- runif(n = n_feats, min = 1, max = 50)
mu_b_yg <- mu_a_yg/3
mu_c_yg <- rnorm(n = n_feats)

mu_a_old <- runif(n = n_feats, min = 1, max = 50)
mu_b_old <- mu_a_old/2
mu_c_old <- rnorm(n = n_feats)
# Covariance matrix
sigma_a_yg <- def_pos_mat(n_feats)  
sigma_b_yg <- sigma_a_yg/3  
sigma_c_yg <- def_pos_mat(n_feats)   

sigma_a_old <- def_pos_mat(n_feats)
sigma_b_old <- sigma_a_old/2
sigma_c_old <- def_pos_mat(n_feats)  

# Generate sample from N(mu, Sigma)
bivn_a_yg <- mvrnorm(2000, mu = mu_a_yg, Sigma = sigma_a_yg )
bivn_b_yg <- mvrnorm(1000, mu = mu_b_yg, Sigma = sigma_b_yg )
bivn_c_yg <- mvrnorm(2000, mu = mu_c_yg, Sigma = sigma_c_yg )

bivn_a_old <- mvrnorm(1500, mu = mu_a_old, Sigma = sigma_a_old )
bivn_b_old <- mvrnorm(2000, mu = mu_b_old, Sigma = sigma_b_old )
bivn_c_old <- mvrnorm(1000, mu = mu_c_old, Sigma = sigma_c_old )

y_a <- c(rep(0, 2000), rep(1, 1500))
y_b <- c(rep(0, 1000), rep(1, 2000))
y_c <- c(rep(0, 2000), rep(1, 1000))

x_a <- rbind(bivn_a_yg, bivn_a_old)
x_b <- rbind(bivn_b_yg, bivn_b_old)
x_c <- rbind(bivn_c_yg, bivn_c_old)

xdata <- scale(rbind(x_a, x_b, x_c))
ydata <- c(y_a, y_b, y_c)
ylabel <- c(rep("a",length(y_a)), rep("b",length(y_b)), rep("c", length(y_b)))

rm(y_a, y_b, y_c, bivn_a_yg, bivn_b_yg, bivn_c_yg, bivn_a_old, 
   bivn_b_old, bivn_c_old, sigma_a_yg, sigma_b_yg, sigma_c_yg, sigma_a_old,
   sigma_b_old, sigma_c_old, mu_a_yg, mu_b_yg, mu_c_yg, mu_a_old, mu_b_old,
   mu_c_old)

data <- data.frame(xdata, y = ydata, label = ylabel)
```

```{r train data}
#Define train and test data
itrain <- sort(sample(nrow(xdata), nrow(xdata)*.9))
```

```{r building correlation matrices}
# this part should receive an arbitrary number of matrices
groups <- unique(data[,'label'])
group_list <- list()

for (i in 1:length(groups)) {
  group_list[[i]] <- data[which(data[,'label'] == groups[i]),!colnames(data) %in% c("y", "label")]
}

# normalizing data
group_list <- lapply(group_list, scale)

## correlation matrices
group_cor <- lapply(group_list, function (x) bigcor(x, y = NULL, fun = "cor", size = 2000, verbose=FALSE))
group_cor <- lapply(group_cor, function (x) as.data.frame(as.ffdf(x)))
```

```{r feature correlation weight - mean}
# angular distance
group_combs <- combn(length(group_cor),2)
ang_weight_mat = matrix(0, nrow = dim(group_combs)[2], ncol = n_feats) #nrows is the number of combinations of the dataset groups in two slots

# matrix of correlation vectors here, between each combination of groups

# to penalize genes with smaller distances in the correlation matrix; try 1 - norm angle
for (i in 1:n_feats){
  for (k in 1:dim(group_combs)[2]) {
    ang_weight_mat[k,i] <- 1 - acos(cosine(group_cor[[group_combs[1,k]]][,i],group_cor[[group_combs[2,k]]][,i]))/pi
  }
}

ang_weight <- apply(ang_weight_mat, 2, mean) #what measurement of central tendency should we use is an open question

pdf("twiner_synthetic_feature-weight_mean.pdf", width = 9)
data.frame(weight = ang_weight) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = weight)) +
    geom_histogram( binwidth=0.01, fill="#69b3a2", color="#e9ecef", alpha=0.9) +
    ggtitle("") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size=15), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
          axis.title.y.left = element_text(size = 30), axis.title.x.bottom = element_text(size = 30),
          axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(size = 30), axis.text.y.left = element_text(size = 30)) +
    xlim(c(0,1)) + 
    xlab("Feature weight") + 
    ylab("Count")
dev.off()

#Train model and save
fit_EN_cv_oldyg <- cv.glmnet(xdata[itrain,], as.factor(ydata[itrain]), family="binomial", nfolds=10, alpha=0.9, penalty.factor=ang_weight, type.measure="mse")

saveRDS(fit_EN_cv_oldyg, "models/disTwiner_meanWeights.rds")
```

```{r evaluate classifier performance - mean}
model_type <- "meanWeights"
fit_EN_cv_oldyg <- readRDS(paste0("models/disTwiner_", model_type, ".rds"))

ypredictions <- predict(fit_EN_cv_oldyg, newx = xdata[-itrain,], type = "class")

# Accuracy and confusion matrix
xtab <- table(ypredictions, ydata[-itrain])
cm <- caret::confusionMatrix(xtab)
cm
pdf(paste0("model_evaluation/confusion_matrix/disTwiner_", model_type, "_cmPlot.pdf"))
draw_confusion_matrix(cm)
dev.off()
saveRDS(cm, paste0("model_evaluation/confusion_matrix/disTwiner_", model_type, "_cm.rds"))

# Precision
precision <- Metrics::precision(ydata[-itrain], as.numeric(ypredictions))
saveRDS(precision, paste0("model_evaluation/precision/disTwiner_", model_type, "_precision.rds"))

# Recall
recall <- Metrics::recall(actual = ydata[-itrain], predicted = as.numeric(ypredictions))
saveRDS(recall, paste0("model_evaluation/recall/disTwiner_", model_type, "_recall.rds"))

#F1 Score
f1 <- Metrics::f1(actual = ydata[-itrain], predicted = as.numeric(ypredictions))
saveRDS(f1, paste0("model_evaluation/f1/disTwiner_", model_type, "_f1.rds"))

#ROC Curve AUC
yprobabilities <- predict(fit_EN_cv_oldyg, newx = xdata[-itrain,], type = "response")[,1]
roc <- roc(ydata[-itrain], yprobabilities)
saveRDS(roc, paste0("model_evaluation/roc/disTwiner_", model_type, "_roc.rds"))

#Distribution standard deviation
std <- sd(ang_weight)
saveRDS(std, paste0("model_evaluation/std/disTwiner_", model_type, "_std.rds"))
```

```{r feature correlation weight - mean of 10% max}
# angular distance
group_combs <- combn(length(group_cor),2)
ang_weight_mat = matrix(0, nrow = dim(group_combs)[2], ncol = n_feats) #nrows is the number of combinations of the dataset groups in two slots

# matrix of correlation vectors here, between each combination of groups

# to penalize genes with smaller distances in the correlation matrix; try 1 - norm angle
for (i in 1:n_feats){
  for (k in 1:dim(group_combs)[2]) {
    ang_weight_mat[k,i] <- 1 - acos(cosine(group_cor[[group_combs[1,k]]][,i],group_cor[[group_combs[2,k]]][,i]))/pi
  }
}

ang_weight <- apply(ang_weight_mat, 2, function(x) mean(x[which(x >= quantile(x, probs = .9, na.rm = TRUE))])) #what measurement of central tendency should we use is an open question

pdf("twiner_synthetic_feature-weight_mean-of-max.pdf")
data.frame(weight = ang_weight) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = weight)) +
    geom_histogram( binwidth=0.01, fill="#69b3a2", color="#e9ecef", alpha=0.9) +
    ggtitle("Feature correlation weights") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size=15), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
          axis.title.y.left = element_text(size = 30), axis.title.x.bottom = element_text(size = 30),
          axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(size = 30), axis.text.y.left = element_text(size = 30)) +
    xlim(c(0,1)) + 
    xlab("Feature weight") + 
    ylab("Count")
dev.off()

#Train model and save
fit_EN_cv_oldyg <- cv.glmnet(xdata[itrain,], as.factor(ydata[itrain]), family="binomial", nfolds=10, alpha=0.9, penalty.factor=ang_weight, type.measure="mse")

saveRDS(fit_EN_cv_oldyg, "models/disTwiner_maximumPercentileWeights.rds")
```

```{r feature correlation weight - mean of 10% min}
# angular distance
group_combs <- combn(length(group_cor),2)
ang_weight_mat = matrix(0, nrow = dim(group_combs)[2], ncol = n_feats) #nrows is the number of combinations of the dataset groups in two slots

# matrix of correlation vectors here, between each combination of groups

# to penalize genes with smaller distances in the correlation matrix; try 1 - norm angle
for (i in 1:n_feats){
  for (k in 1:dim(group_combs)[2]) {
    ang_weight_mat[k,i] <- 1 - acos(cosine(group_cor[[group_combs[1,k]]][,i],group_cor[[group_combs[2,k]]][,i]))/pi
  }
}

ang_weight <- apply(ang_weight_mat, 2, function(x) mean(x[which(x <= quantile(x, probs = .1, na.rm = TRUE))])) #what measurement of central tendency should we use is an open question

pdf("twiner_synthetic_feature-weight_mean-of-min.pdf")
data.frame(weight = ang_weight) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = weight)) +
    geom_histogram( binwidth=0.01, fill="#69b3a2", color="#e9ecef", alpha=0.9) +
    ggtitle("Feature correlation weights") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size=15), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
          axis.title.y.left = element_text(size = 30), axis.title.x.bottom = element_text(size = 30),
          axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(size = 30), axis.text.y.left = element_text(size = 30)) +
    xlim(c(0,1)) + 
    xlab("Feature weight") + 
    ylab("Count")
dev.off()

#Train model and save
fit_EN_cv_oldyg <- cv.glmnet(xdata[itrain,], as.factor(ydata[itrain]), family="binomial", nfolds=10, alpha=0.9, penalty.factor=ang_weight, type.measure="mse")

saveRDS(fit_EN_cv_oldyg, "models/disTwiner_minimumPercentileWeights.rds")
```

```{r feature correlation weight - exponential score}
# angular distance
group_combs <- combn(length(group_cor),2)
ang_weight_mat = matrix(0, nrow = dim(group_combs)[2], ncol = n_feats) #nrows is the number of combinations of the dataset groups in two slots

# matrix of correlation vectors here, between each combination of groups

# to penalize genes with smaller distances in the correlation matrix; try 1 - norm angle
for (i in 1:n_feats){
  for (k in 1:dim(group_combs)[2]) {
    ang_weight_mat[k,i] <- exp(1 - acos(cosine(group_cor[[group_combs[1,k]]][,i],group_cor[[group_combs[2,k]]][,i]))/pi)
  }
}
```

```{r feature correlation weight - sigmoid score}
# angular distance
group_combs <- combn(length(group_cor),2)
ang_weight_mat = matrix(0, nrow = dim(group_combs)[2], ncol = n_feats) #nrows is the number of combinations of the dataset groups in two slots

# matrix of correlation vectors here, between each combination of groups

# to penalize genes with smaller distances in the correlation matrix; try 1 - norm angle
for (i in 1:n_feats){
  for (k in 1:dim(group_combs)[2]) {
    ang_weight_mat[k,i] <- 1/(1+exp(-(1 - acos(cosine(group_cor[[group_combs[1,k]]][,i],group_cor[[group_combs[2,k]]][,i]))/pi)))
  }
}
```

```{r evaluate classifier performance - svm}
#Train model and save
model_type <- "SVM"

dataset <- data.frame(cbind(xdata, ydata))
dataset$ydata <- factor(dataset$ydata, levels = c(0, 1)) 

training_set = dataset[itrain,]
test_set = dataset[-itrain,]

training_set[,-101] = scale(training_set[,-101]) 
test_set[,-101] = scale(test_set[,-101]) 

classifier = svm(formula = ydata ~ ., 
                 data = training_set, 
                 type = 'C-classification', 
                 kernel = 'linear', probability = TRUE)

saveRDS(classifier, paste0("models/disTwiner_", model_type, ".rds"))

y_pred = predict(classifier, newdata = test_set[,-101])
```

```{r load immune data}
srt.immune <- readRDS("E:/Storage/rna_seq_datasets/immune_seurat_norm_annotated.rds") %>%
  subset(subset = cell_label %in% c("lateMacs", "repMacs", "intMacs", "regMacs 1", "regMacs 2", "infMacs"))

xdata <- t(as.matrix(GetAssayData(srt.immune, "data")))

xdata <- xdata[,sapply(seq(ncol(xdata)), function(ix) {sd(xdata[,ix])}) != 0]

ydata <- c(rep(0, length(srt.immune$Condition)))
for (i in 1:length(srt.immune$Condition)) {
  ydata[i] <- 0*(unname(srt.immune$Condition)[i] == "Young") + 1*(unname(srt.immune$Condition)[i] == "Old")
}

ydata <- as.numeric(ydata)

ylabel <- as.character(unname(srt.immune$cell_label))

data <- data.frame(xdata, y = ydata, label = ylabel)

rm(srt.immune)

itrain <- sort(sample(nrow(xdata), nrow(xdata)*.9))
```

```{r building correlation matrices}
# this part should receive an arbitrary number of matrices
groups <- unique(data[,'label'])
group_list <- list()

for (i in 1:length(groups)) {
  group_list[[i]] <- data[which(data[,'label'] == groups[i]),!colnames(data) %in% c("y", "label")]
}

# filter genes with no sample variability
for (i in 1:length(groups)) {
  group_list[[i]] <- group_list[[i]][,sapply(seq(ncol(group_list[[i]])), function(ix) {sd(group_list[[i]][,ix])}) != 0]
}

# select only common genes between groups
col_common = colnames(xdata)
for (i in 1:length(group_list)){
  col_common = intersect(col_common, colnames(group_list[[i]]))
}

group_list <- lapply(group_list, function(x) x[, col_common])

xdata <- scale(xdata[, col_common])

# normalizing data
group_list <- lapply(group_list, scale)

## correlation matrices
# group_cor <- lapply(group_list, function (x) bigcor(x, y = NULL, fun = "cor", size = 2000, verbose=FALSE))
# group_cor <- lapply(group_cor, function (x) as.data.frame(as.ffdf(x)))
# group_cor <- lapply(group_cor, function (x) x %>% mutate(across(everything(), replace_na, 0)))
group_cor <- readRDS("group_correlation_mat_macs.rds")
```

```{r gene correlation weight}
group_combs <- combn(length(group_cor),2)
n_feats <- dim(xdata)[2]
ang_weight_mat = matrix(0, nrow = dim(group_combs)[2], ncol = n_feats) 
for (i in 1:n_feats){
  for (k in 1:dim(group_combs)[2]) {
    ang_weight_mat[k,i] <- exp(1 - acos(cosine(group_cor[[group_combs[1,k]]][,i],group_cor[[group_combs[2,k]]][,i]))/pi)
  }
}

ang_weight_mat[is.na(ang_weight_mat)] <- 0

ang_weight <- apply(ang_weight_mat, 2, function(x) min(x[x > 0])) 

pdf("disTwiner_macs_feature-weight.pdf", width = 9)
data.frame(weight = ang_weight) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = weight)) +
    geom_histogram( binwidth=0.01, fill="#69b3a2", color="#e9ecef", alpha=0.9) +
    ggtitle("") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size=15), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
          axis.title.y.left = element_text(size = 30), axis.title.x.bottom = element_text(size = 30),
          axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(size = 30), axis.text.y.left = element_text(size = 30)) +
    xlim(c(0,1)) + 
    xlab("Feature weight") + 
    ylab("Count")
dev.off()

rm(group_cor, group_list, group_combs, data, ang_weight_mat)
gc()

#Train model and save
fit_EN_cv_oldyg <- cv.glmnet(xdata[itrain,], as.factor(ydata[itrain]), family="binomial", nfolds=10, alpha=0.9, penalty.factor=ang_weight, type.measure="mse")

saveRDS(fit_EN_cv_oldyg, "models/disTwiner_macs.rds")
```

```{r evaluate SVM performance}
test_set2<- test_set[,which(complete.cases(test_set_temp))]

y_pred = predict(classifier, newdata = test_set2[,-16645])

# Accuracy and confusion matrix
xtab <- table(y_pred, ydata[-itrain])
cm <- caret::confusionMatrix(xtab)
cm
pdf(paste0("real_data_evaluation/confusion_matrix/", model_type, "_cmPlot.pdf"))
draw_confusion_matrix(cm)
dev.off()
saveRDS(cm, paste0("real_data_evaluation/confusion_matrix/", model_type, "_cm.rds"))

# Precision
precision <- Metrics::precision(ydata[-itrain], as.numeric(y_pred))
saveRDS(precision, paste0("real_data_evaluation/precision/", model_type, "_precision.rds"))

# Recall
recall <- Metrics::recall(actual = ydata[-itrain], predicted = as.numeric(y_pred))
saveRDS(recall, paste0("real_data_evaluation/recall/", model_type, "_recall.rds"))

#F1 Score
f1 <- Metrics::f1(actual = ydata[-itrain], predicted = as.numeric(y_pred))
saveRDS(f1, paste0("real_data_evaluation/f1/", model_type, "_f1.rds"))

#ROC Curve AUC
yprobabilities <- predict(classifier, newdata = test_set[-101], type = "prob", probability = TRUE)
yprobabilities <- attr(yprobabilities,"probabilities")[,2]
roc <- roc(ydata[-itrain], yprobabilities)
saveRDS(roc, paste0("real_data_evaluation/roc/", model_type, "_roc.rds"))
```

```{r assess if identified features are differentially expressed with age in the macrophage populations}
for (i in 1:length(genes_lfc$genes)) {
```

```{r assess genes using GSEA to detect group-specific enrichment and compare it with standard enrichment analysis}
genes_selected <- readRDS("macs_cvglmnet_genes_selected.rds")

gene_sets = msigdbr(species = "mouse", category = "H")
msigdbr_list = split(x = gene_sets$gene_symbol, f = gene_sets$gs_name)

## REPMACS
# Enrichment of repmacs without filtering of selected features
markers_no_filter <- readRDS("dgea_output/dgea_macs_immune_clusters_fgsea.rds") %>%
  filter(cluster == "repMacs")
ranks_no_filter <- markers_no_filter$avg_log2FC
names(ranks_no_filter) <- rownames(markers_no_filter)
fgseaRes_no_filter <- fgsea(pathways = msigdbr_list,
                  stats = ranks_no_filter,
                  minSize=10,
                  maxSize=500,
                  nproc=1,
                  scoreType="pos")

fgseaResTidy_no_filter <- fgseaRes_no_filter %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  arrange(desc(NES))

ggplot(fgseaResTidy_no_filter %>% dplyr::filter(abs(NES) > 1), aes(reorder(pathway, NES), NES)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill=padj<0.05)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x="Pathway", y="Normalized Enrichment Score",
       title=paste0(paste0("repMacs - Non-filtered pathways"))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10))

# Enrichment of repmacs with filtering of selected features
markers <- readRDS("dgea_output/dgea_macs_immune_clusters_fgsea.rds") %>%
  filter(cluster == "repMacs") %>%
  filter(gene %in% genes_selected)
ranks <- markers$avg_log2FC
names(ranks) <- rownames(markers)
fgseaRes <- fgsea(pathways = msigdbr_list,
                  stats = ranks,
                  minSize=10,
                  maxSize=500,
                  nproc=1,
                  scoreType="pos")

fgseaResTidy <- fgseaRes %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  arrange(desc(NES))

ggplot(fgseaResTidy %>% dplyr::filter(abs(NES) > 1), aes(reorder(pathway, NES), NES)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill=padj<0.05)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x="Pathway", y="Normalized Enrichment Score",
       title=paste0(paste0("repMacs - Filtered pathways"))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10))
```

```{r assess genes using CellChat and compare with previously obtained results - prepare cellchat}
  if (de_genes_age$logFC[i] < 0) {
    de_genes_age$datasets[i] <- 'Young'
  } else {
    de_genes_age$datasets[i] <- 'Old'
  }
}
cellchat@var.features$Old.info <- de_genes_age
cellchat@var.features[['Old']] <- de_genes_age$features
rm(de_genes_age, de_genes_immune_age, de_genes_muscle_age)
# ---

net <- netMappingDEG(cellchat, features.name = features.name)
net.target_muSC <- filter(net, target %in% target_cell)
net.target_muSC.source_immune <- filter(net.target_muSC, source %in% immune_cells_present)
net.target_muSC.source_immune <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune, !is.na(ligand.pvalues))

net.target_muSC.source_immune.secreted <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune, annotation == "Secreted Signaling")
net.target_muSC.source_immune.contact <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune, annotation == "Cell-Cell Contact")
net.target_muSC.source_immune.ecm <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune, annotation == "ECM-Receptor")

net.target_muSC.source_immune.secreted.up <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune.secreted, (!is.na(receptor.logFC) & receptor.logFC > 0 & ligand.logFC > LogFC_threshold) | (is.na(receptor.logFC) & ligand.logFC > LogFC_threshold))
net.target_muSC.source_immune.secreted.down <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune.secreted, (!is.na(receptor.logFC) & receptor.logFC < 0 & ligand.logFC < -LogFC_threshold) | (is.na(receptor.logFC) & ligand.logFC < -LogFC_threshold))

net.target_muSC.source_immune.contact.up <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune.contact, (!is.na(receptor.logFC) & receptor.logFC > 0 & ligand.logFC > LogFC_threshold) | (is.na(receptor.logFC) & ligand.logFC > LogFC_threshold))
net.target_muSC.source_immune.contact.down <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune.contact, (!is.na(receptor.logFC) & receptor.logFC < 0 & ligand.logFC < -LogFC_threshold) | (is.na(receptor.logFC) & ligand.logFC < -LogFC_threshold))

net.target_muSC.source_immune.ecm.up <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune.ecm, (!is.na(receptor.logFC) & receptor.logFC > 0 & ligand.logFC > LogFC_threshold) | (is.na(receptor.logFC) & ligand.logFC > LogFC_threshold))
net.target_muSC.source_immune.ecm.down <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune.ecm, (!is.na(receptor.logFC) & receptor.logFC < 0 & ligand.logFC < -LogFC_threshold) | (is.na(receptor.logFC) & ligand.logFC < -LogFC_threshold))
```

```{r compare classification with other classifiers}
# Load data again
srt.immune <- readRDS("E:/Storage/rna_seq_datasets/immune_seurat_norm_annotated.rds") %>%
  subset(subset = cell_label %in% c("lateMacs", "repMacs", "intMacs", "regMacs 1", "regMacs 2", "infMacs"))

xdata <- t(as.matrix(GetAssayData(srt.immune, "data")))

xdata <- xdata[,sapply(seq(ncol(xdata)), function(ix) {sd(xdata[,ix])}) != 0]

ydata <- c(rep(0, length(srt.immune$Condition)))
for (i in 1:length(srt.immune$Condition)) {
  ydata[i] <- 0*(unname(srt.immune$Condition)[i] == "Young") + 1*(unname(srt.immune$Condition)[i] == "Old")
}

rm(srt.immune)

# Logistic regression with Elastic Net regularization
set.seed(123)
itrain <- sort(sample(nrow(xdata), nrow(xdata)*.9))

fit_EN_cv_oldyg <- cv.glmnet(xdata[itrain,], as.factor(ydata[itrain]), family="binomial", nfolds=10, alpha=0.9, type.measure="mse")

var_selected_idx <- which(fit_EN_cv_oldyg$glmnet.fit$beta[,which(fit_EN_cv_oldyg$cvm == min(fit_EN_cv_oldyg$cvm))] != 0)

var_selected <- colnames(xdata)[var_selected_idx]

print("Evaluate classifier on training data - Logistic + Elastic Net")
assess.glmnet(fit_EN_cv_oldyg, newx = xdata[itrain, ], newy = as.factor(ydata[itrain]))

cnf <- confusion.glmnet(fit_EN_cv_oldyg, newx = xdata[itrain, ], newy = as.factor(ydata[itrain]))
print(cnf)

cfit_train <- cv.glmnet(xdata[itrain,], as.factor(ydata[itrain]), family = "binomial", nfolds=10, alpha=0.9, type.measure = "auc", keep = TRUE)
rocs <- roc.glmnet(cfit_train$fit.preval, newy = as.factor(ydata[itrain]))
best <- cfit_train$index["min",]
plot(rocs[[best]], type = "l")
invisible(sapply(rocs, lines, col="grey"))
lines(rocs[[best]], lwd = 2,col = "red")

print("Evaluate classifier on test data - Logistic + Elastic Net")
assess.glmnet(fit_EN_cv_oldyg, newx = xdata[-itrain, ], newy = as.factor(ydata[-itrain]))

cnf <- confusion.glmnet(fit_EN_cv_oldyg, newx = xdata[-itrain, ], newy = as.factor(ydata[-itrain]))
print(cnf)
saveRDS(cnf, "logistic_elastic_confusionmatrix.rds")

pdf("logistic_macs_roc.pdf")
cfit_test <- cv.glmnet(xdata[-itrain,], as.factor(ydata[-itrain]), family = "binomial", nfolds=10, alpha=0.9, type.measure = "auc", keep = TRUE)
rocs <- roc.glmnet(cfit_test$fit.preval, newy = as.factor(ydata[-itrain]))
best <- cfit_test$index["min",]
plot(rocs[[best]], type = "l")
invisible(sapply(rocs, lines, col="grey"))
lines(rocs[[best]], lwd = 2,col = "red")
dev.off()

# Random forest

xtrain <- xdata[itrain,]
xtest <- xdata[-itrain,]
ytrain <- as.factor(ydata[itrain])
ytest <- as.factor(ydata[-itrain])

rf <- randomForest(x = xtrain, y = ytrain, xtest = xtest, ytest = ytest)
saveRDS(rf, "randomForest_model.rds")

confusionMatrix(rf$predicted, reference = ytrain)
confusionMatrix(rf$test$predicted, reference = ytest)

predictions <- rf$test$votes
predictions <- cbind(predictions, factor(as.numeric(rf$test$predicted) - 1))
predictions <- cbind(predictions, factor(as.numeric(ytest) - 1))
predictions[, 3:4] <- predictions[, 3:4] - 1
predictions <- as.data.frame(predictions)
colnames(predictions) = c("0", "1", "predict", "observed")

precrec_obj <- evalmod(scores = predictions$predict, labels = predictions$observed)
pdf("randomForest_macs_roc.pdf")
autoplot(precrec_obj)
dev.off()

# SVM

dataset <- data.frame(cbind(xdata, ydata))
dataset$ydata <- factor(dataset$ydata, levels = c(0, 1)) 

training_set = dataset[itrain,]
test_set = dataset[-itrain,]

training_set[,-16836] = scale(training_set[,-16836]) 
test_set[,-16836] = scale(test_set[,-16836]) 

classifier = svm(formula = ydata ~ ., 
                 data = training_set, 
                 type = 'C-classification', 
                 kernel = 'linear') 

y_pred = predict(classifier, newdata = test_set[-16836]) 

cm = table(test_set[, 16836], y_pred) 
saveRDS(cm, "SVM_confusionmatrix.rds")
```

```{r LR analysis with Twiner features only}
de_genes_muscle_age$cluster <- gsub("Teno", "Tenocytes", de_genes_muscle_age$cluster)
de_genes_muscle_age$cluster <- gsub("Neural", "Neural/Schwann cells", de_genes_muscle_age$cluster)
de_genes_muscle_age$cluster <- gsub("Myo", "Myocytes", de_genes_muscle_age$cluster)
de_genes_muscle_age$cluster <- gsub("activSat", "Quiescent/early activation MuSCs", de_genes_muscle_age$cluster)
de_genes_muscle_age$cluster <- gsub("Mural", "Mural cells", de_genes_muscle_age$cluster)

de_genes_muscle_age <- filter(de_genes_muscle_age, cluster %in% muscle_cells_present)
de_genes_age <- rbind(de_genes_immune_age, de_genes_muscle_age) %>% filter(abs(avg_log2FC) > LogFC_threshold)
de_genes_age <- data.frame(clusters = de_genes_age$cluster, features = de_genes_age$gene, pvalues = de_genes_age$p_val, logFC = de_genes_age$avg_log2FC, pct.1 = de_genes_age$pct.1, pct.2 = de_genes_age$pct.2, pvalues.adj = de_genes_age$p_val_adj)
de_genes_age$datasets <-  NA
for (i in 1:length(de_genes_age$datasets)) {
  if (de_genes_age$logFC[i] < 0) {
    de_genes_age$datasets[i] <- 'Young'
  } else {
    de_genes_age$datasets[i] <- 'Old'
  }
}
cellchat@var.features$Old.info <- de_genes_age
cellchat@var.features[['Old']] <- de_genes_age$features
rm(de_genes_age, de_genes_immune_age, de_genes_muscle_age)
# ---

net <- netMappingDEG(cellchat, features.name = features.name)
net.target_muSC <- filter(net, target %in% target_cell)
net.target_muSC.source_immune <- filter(net.target_muSC, source %in% immune_cells_present)
net.target_muSC.source_immune <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune, !is.na(ligand.pvalues))

net.target_muSC.source_immune.secreted <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune, annotation == "Secreted Signaling")
net.target_muSC.source_immune.contact <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune, annotation == "Cell-Cell Contact")
net.target_muSC.source_immune.ecm <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune, annotation == "ECM-Receptor")

net.target_muSC.source_immune.secreted.up <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune.secreted, (!is.na(receptor.logFC) & receptor.logFC > 0 & ligand.logFC > LogFC_threshold) | (is.na(receptor.logFC) & ligand.logFC > LogFC_threshold))
net.target_muSC.source_immune.secreted.down <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune.secreted, (!is.na(receptor.logFC) & receptor.logFC < 0 & ligand.logFC < -LogFC_threshold) | (is.na(receptor.logFC) & ligand.logFC < -LogFC_threshold))

net.target_muSC.source_immune.contact.up <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune.contact, (!is.na(receptor.logFC) & receptor.logFC > 0 & ligand.logFC > LogFC_threshold) | (is.na(receptor.logFC) & ligand.logFC > LogFC_threshold))
net.target_muSC.source_immune.contact.down <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune.contact, (!is.na(receptor.logFC) & receptor.logFC < 0 & ligand.logFC < -LogFC_threshold) | (is.na(receptor.logFC) & ligand.logFC < -LogFC_threshold))

net.target_muSC.source_immune.ecm.up <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune.ecm, (!is.na(receptor.logFC) & receptor.logFC > 0 & ligand.logFC > LogFC_threshold) | (is.na(receptor.logFC) & ligand.logFC > LogFC_threshold))
net.target_muSC.source_immune.ecm.down <- filter(net.target_muSC.source_immune.ecm, (!is.na(receptor.logFC) & receptor.logFC < 0 & ligand.logFC < -LogFC_threshold) | (is.na(receptor.logFC) & ligand.logFC < -LogFC_threshold))

colors.use <- c("#dda15e", "#780000", "#dda15e", "#dda15e", "#dda15e", "#dda15e", "#dda15e", "#dda15e", "#dda15e", "#dda15e", "#dda15e", "#dda15e", "#70e000", "#669bbc", "#c1121f", "#259638", "#003049", "#dda15e")

pdf("twiner_lr_cellchat_3dpi_up_signaling_twinerOnly.pdf", width = 10)
netVisual_chord_gene(object.list[[2]], slot.name = 'net', net = net.target_muSC.source_immune.secreted.up, lab.cex = 0.8, small.gap = 3.5,  title.name = paste0("Up-regulated secreted signaling in ", names(object.list)[2]))
dev.off()
#netVisual_chord_gene(object.list[[2]], slot.name = 'net', net = net.target_muSC.source_immune.contact.up, lab.cex = 0.8, small.gap = 3.5, title.name = paste0("Up-regulated cell-cell contact in ", names(object.list)[2]))
# netVisual_chord_gene(object.list[[2]], slot.name = 'net', net = net.target_muSC.source_immune.ecm.up, lab.cex = 0.8, small.gap = 3.5, title.name = paste0("Up-regulated ECM-receptor in ", names(object.list)[2]))

pdf("twiner_lr_cellchat_3dpi_down_signaling_twinerOnly.pdf", width = 10)
netVisual_chord_gene(object.list[[1]], slot.name = 'net', net = net.target_muSC.source_immune.secreted.down, lab.cex = 0.8, small.gap = 3.5, title.name = paste0("Down-regulated secreted signaling in ", names(object.list)[2]))
dev.off()
pdf("twiner_lr_cellchat_3dpi_down_contact_twinerOnly.pdf", width = 10)
netVisual_chord_gene(object.list[[1]], slot.name = 'net', net = net.target_muSC.source_immune.contact.down, lab.cex = 0.8, small.gap = 3.5, title.name = paste0("Down-regulated cell-cell contact in ", names(object.list)[2]))
dev.off()
pdf("twiner_lr_cellchat_3dpi_down_ecm_twinerOnly.pdf")
netVisual_chord_gene(object.list[[1]], slot.name = 'net', net = net.target_muSC.source_immune.ecm.down, lab.cex = 1.2, small.gap = 3.5, title.name = paste0("Down-regulated ECM-receptor in ", names(object.list)[2]), color.use = colors.use, legend.pos.x = 5, legend.pos.y = 15)
dev.off()

```
